First-ever expansion of D.C.’s iconic Old Ebbitt Grill opens its doors at 1860 Reston Row Plaza in The Row at Reston Station

RESTON, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Comstock Holding Companies, Inc. (Nasdaq: CHCI) (“Comstock”), a leading real estate company specializing in the development, acquisition, operation, and management of mixed-use, transit-oriented properties and data center developments, today announced the grand opening of Ebbitt House at Reston Station. Located at 1860 Reston Row Plaza in The Row at Reston Station, the 12,000-square-foot restaurant opens its doors to the public today at 11 a.m. and will welcome guests daily. Reservations are now open via EbbittHouse.com and OpenTable.

Named after the original 1856 boarding house that gave rise to the legendary Old Ebbitt Grill, Ebbitt House marks the first-ever expansion of the storied brand outside of downtown D.C. in its 170-year history. Designed as a contemporary evolution of the D.C. landmark, the venue brings the signature Clyde’s Restaurant Group (“CRG”) hospitality, classic American fare, lively bar culture, and renowned raw bar to Northern Virginia’s premier mixed-use, transit-oriented neighborhood.

Ebbitt House features more than 400 seats spread across its 275+ guest dining room, two private dining rooms, and all-season patio. Two indoor bars anchor the main dining areas that are complemented by a dedicated outdoor patio bar. A full oyster and raw bar sits at the heart of the restaurant, carrying forward one of Old Ebbitt Grill’s best-known traditions, alongside a menu of elevated American classics that have drawn generations of guests to the original. Located steps from the Wiehle-Reston East Station on Metro's Silver Line, Ebbitt House is positioned as a destination for business lunches, after-work gatherings, and celebratory events alike.

“Ebbitt House is one of the most anticipated restaurant openings in Northern Virginia's history, and we are proud that CRG chose Reston Station for the first-ever expansion of such an iconic brand,” said Tim Steffan, Chief Operating Officer of Comstock. “Its arrival, alongside the JW Marriott Reston Station and our growing roster of best-in-class dining and retail, further cements Reston Station as the premier place to live, work, stay, and gather in the Dulles Corridor.”

The opening of Ebbitt House in Reston Station also marks CRG’s return to the area. CRG previously operated Clyde’s of Reston at Reston Town Center for more than 30 years, and several familiar faces from that team have rejoined to lead Ebbitt House, including General Manager Ajay Bhatia and Executive Chef Diego Ramirez.

"Reston has always held a special place in our history, and we are thrilled to return to this thriving community with a bold new chapter of the Ebbitt story," said John McDonnell, President and CEO of Clyde’s Restaurant Group. "Ebbitt House honors and expands upon the traditions guests love about Old Ebbitt Grill, from our renowned raw bar to our classic American hospitality, while introducing an elevated menu and an energetic, modern space tailored specifically for Reston Station."

Reston Station is among the largest and most prominent mixed-use, transit-oriented developments in the Mid-Atlantic region, covering approximately 90 acres spanning across the Dulles Toll Road and surrounding the Wiehle-Reston East Station on Metro’s Silver Line. Its first two phases feature five Trophy-Class office buildings, two luxury high-rise apartment towers, and Virginia’s first and only JW Marriott – a 28-story tower that includes the world-class JW Marriott Reston Station hotel and the ultra-premium JW Marriott Residences, both of which set the new standard for luxury in the D.C. region. A growing collection of signature dining, retail, and wellness options include Ebbitt House, Founding Farmers, Davio’s Northern Italian Steakhouse, Starbucks, a 55,000-square-foot VIDA Fitness and Spa, CVS, and more. For more information, please visit RestonStation.com.

About Comstock

Comstock (Nasdaq: CHCI) is a leading real estate company specializing in the development, acquisition, operation, and management of mixed-use, transit-oriented properties and data center developments. With over four decades of industry expertise, Comstock’s vertically integrated operating platform delivers long-term value across a rapidly growing portfolio of premier properties that includes two of the most prominent mixed-use, transit-oriented developments in the Mid-Atlantic region. Leveraging its scalable, asset-light, debt-free business model, Comstock has strategically expanded into large-scale AI and digital infrastructure development and established an active position in one of the real estate industry's top-performing segments. For more information, please visit Comstock.com.

ARLINGTON, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Apartments.com, an industry-leading online marketplace of CoStar Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: CSGP), released its latest U.S. multifamily construction activity update for the third quarter of 2026.

National apartment construction starts totaled about 76,000 units in Q3 2026, down 63% from the peak of nearly 206,000 units in Q1 2022 and the lowest quarterly total since 2012. Over the past 12 months, starts totaled about 342,000 units, the lowest annual pace since 2014 and roughly three-quarters of the units delivered over the same period.

As a result, the pipeline continues to shrink. About 593,000 units were under construction nationwide in the third quarter. That is roughly half the early 2023 peak of nearly 1.2 million and the 14th consecutive quarterly decline, returning the pipeline to mid-2016 levels.

"Developers are still breaking ground on far fewer projects than they're finishing, and that gap is reshaping the supply outlook market by market," said Grant Montgomery, national director of U.S. multifamily analytics at CoStar Group. "In places where starts have pulled back the furthest, the wave of new apartments that defined the past few years is giving way to a much thinner pipeline ahead."

Completions are also easing. About 446,000 units were delivered over the past four quarters, down 22% from a year earlier and 36% below the 2024 peak.

At the market level, New York City has the largest pipeline at about 46,000 units, followed by Dallas-Fort Worth at roughly 32,000. Relative to existing inventory, Miami leads with about 9% of its apartment stock under construction, followed by Charlotte and Fort Lauderdale at more than 6%.

The pullback is especially sharp in Texas, home to three of the six most active markets for apartment starts during the building boom. Combined starts over the past 12 months across Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, Austin and San Antonio are down about 42% from a year earlier.

KEY FACTS

  • SUNHARBO® (asundexian) is now available to order for hospitals, health systems and pharmacies in the U.S.
  • SUNHARBO was recently approved by the U.S. FDA to be used in combination with antiplatelet therapy to reduce the risk of stroke in adults with recent non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke (NIH Stroke Scale ≤ 15) or high-risk transient ischemic attack (TIA).1

WHIPPANY, N.J.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Bayer announced today that SUNHARBO® (asundexian), 50 mg tablets, is now available to order in the United States. Hospitals, health systems and pharmacies have immediate access to order the product for inventory. SUNHARBO is the first approved Factor XIa inhibitor in the U.S. and represents the first in a new class of medicine.1

SUNHARBO is indicated in combination with antiplatelet therapy to reduce the risk of stroke in adults with recent non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke (NIH Stroke Scale ≤ 15) or high-risk transient ischemic attack (TIA).1

BAYER EXECUTIVE COMMENTARY
“The swift availability of SUNHARBO reinforces our commitment to patients,” said Nelson Ambrogio, President of Bayer U.S. Pharmaceuticals. “We are proud of the progress Bayer has made in bringing forward a new option for secondary stroke prevention.”

EXPERT COMMENTARY
“I want to see new secondary stroke prevention therapies available to healthcare professionals and their patients as quickly as possible,” said Mike Sharma, M.D., Principal investigator of the Population Health Research Institute (PHRI) OCEANIC-STROKE study, Senior Scientist at PHRI, and Director of the Stroke Program at Hamilton Health Sciences. “Now that SUNHARBO can be ordered for pharmacy inventory in the U.S., let’s recognize that we are taking another great step forward toward that goal.”

To support patients, Bayer is offering several programs designed to facilitate therapy initiation and continuity of care, including co-pay offers and patient education. For more information, visit here: https://www.sunharbosavings.com/.

The list price for SUNHARBO will be $748.50 for a 30-day supply. The list price does not reflect what most health plans or patients will pay. Costs will vary by health plan, and patients’ out-of-pocket costs will depend on their coverage, such as deductibles and copays. The list price may be subject to change without prior notifications.

Bayer is committed to making SUNHARBO accessible. If a patient cannot afford their prescription, Bayer may be able to help. Eligible patients may receive their Bayer prescription medicine at no cost through the Bayer U.S. Patient Assistance Foundation. For more information, please visit www.patientassistance.bayer.us or call to speak with a member of Bayer’s team at 1-866-2BUSPAF (228-7723).

About SUNHARBO® (asundexian)
SUNHARBO is a once-daily, first-in-class, oral Factor XIa inhibitor approved by the U.S. FDA and indicated in combination with antiplatelet therapy to reduce the risk of stroke in adults with recent non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke (NIHSS≤15) or high-risk transient ischemic attack (TIA). SUNHARBO is the first approved Factor XIa inhibitor in the U.S. and represents the first medicine in a new class designed to target Factor XIa. SUNHARBO is an inhibitor of Factor XIa. Factor XIa inhibition reduces amplification of thrombin generation. In preclinical models, Factor XIa inhibition targets more pathological clotting (thrombosis) with lesser impact on normal clotting response (hemostasis).1

SUNHARBO was approved based on results from the pivotal Phase 3 OCEANIC-STROKE study where SUNHARBO significantly reduced ischemic stroke in patients after a recent non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke or high-risk transient ischemic attack compared to placebo (6.2% vs. 8.4%; HR 0.74; 95% CI, 0.65–0.84; P<0.0001), both in combination with antiplatelet therapy.1

For additional information about SUNHARBO, healthcare professionals may visit SUNHARBOhcp.com. Please see the full prescribing information.

IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

CONTRAINDICATIONS and WARNINGS & PRECAUTIONS
None.

ADVERSE REACTIONS
Bleeding

  • The rate of International Society on Thrombosis and Haemostasis (ISTH) major bleeding was similar between SUNHARBO and placebo groups (1.6 vs. 1.5 per 100 patient-years).
  • The rate of ISTH major bleeding events within 90 days of treatment initiation was 4.5 vs. 3.1 per 100 patient-years in the SUNHARBO and placebo groups, respectively.
  • In patients planned to receive DAPT, the rate of ISTH major bleeding events was 1.9 vs. 1.5 per 100 patient-years in the SUNHARBO and placebo groups, respectively.
  • Among patients older than 75 years, the rate of ISTH major bleeding was 2.6 vs. 1.7 per 100 patient-years in the SUNHARBO and placebo groups, respectively.
  • In the high-risk TIA subgroup, the rate of ISTH major bleeding was 2.9 vs. 1.0 per 100 patient-years in the SUNHARBO and placebo groups, respectively.
  • The rate of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding was higher in the SUNHARBO compared to placebo group (2.7 vs. 2.1 per 100 patient-years). The majority of GI bleeding events in the SUNHARBO group (74%) were clinically relevant non-major or minor bleeding, and the most frequent bleeding site was of rectal origin.

Diarrhea

  • The most frequently reported (> 3%) adverse reaction in SUNHARBO-treated patients was diarrhea.

Hepatic Enzyme Increased

  • SUNHARBO is associated with elevated hepatic enzymes. Substantial cholestatic liver injury or serious liver injury with jaundice were each reported in less than 0.02% of SUNHARBO-treated patients.

DRUG INTERACTIONS

  • P-glycoprotein (P-gp) substrates - Concomitant use of SUNHARBO increased the exposure to digoxin. For digoxin and sensitive P-gp substrates where minimal concentration changes may increase the risk of adverse reactions, follow the recommendation in their approved product labeling.
  • Combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inducers - Avoid concomitant use with combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inducers, which decreases SUNHARBO exposure and may lead to loss of efficacy.

USE IN SPECIFIC POPULATIONS

Pregnancy

  • There are risks to the mother associated with untreated non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke or TIA and risk of bleeding in the mother and fetus or neonate associated with use of anticoagulants during pregnancy.

Lactation

  • Breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment with SUNHARBO and for 5 days after the last dose due to the potential for serious adverse reactions in nursing infants, including bleeding.

Hepatic Impairment

  • Patients with moderate to severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh B and C) may have intrinsic coagulation abnormalities and use of SUNHARBO in these patients is not recommended.

For additional important risk and use information, please see the full Prescribing Information.

You are encouraged to report side effects or quality complaints of prescription drugs to the FDA. Visit www.fda.gov/medwatch or call 1-800-FDA-1088.

About Bayer’s Stroke Franchise
Bayer is a leader in cardiovascular (CV) and cerebrovascular diseases, with a longstanding legacy of scientific innovation in the prevention and treatment of thrombotic conditions. Building on this heritage, Bayer is advancing innovative approaches to help address unmet needs in stroke, with a focus on the area of secondary stroke prevention and research into new pathways, including Factor XIa. Bayer aims to help shape the future of stroke care with products strategically positioned to help address critical unmet needs and drive significant long-term value. Bayer is working alongside the stroke community to better understand unmet needs and support patients and care partners across the stroke journey.

In line with its mission, “Health for all, Hunger for none,” the company’s products and services are designed to support efforts to master major challenges presented by a growing and aging global population and create value through innovation and growth. The Bayer brand stands for trust, reliability and quality throughout the world. In fiscal 2025, the Group employed around 88,000 people and had sales of 45.6 billion euros. Anthropic joins SpaceX as Genius Group’s second AI Treasury look-through holding to go public since the Company’s first investments in June 2026

Anthropic’s valuation has increased 295% from its valuation when the Company gained pre-IPO Anthropic exposure during its first AI Treasury investment

AI Treasury also includes pre-IPO exposure to OpenAI, Databricks and Anduril

SINGAPORE, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Genius Group Limited (NYSE American: GNS) (“Genius Group”, “GNS” or the “Company”), a leading AI-powered education group, is providing today an update to its shareholders on its AI Treasury, further to Anthropic’s initial public offering yesterday.

On May 27, 2026, the Company’s Board of Directors approved the launch of the Genius AI Treasury, with a plan to deploy up to US$100 million of initial capital as the first phase of a US$800 million, five-year investment program into companies leading the development of Artificial General Intelligence (“AGI”). The Company’s AGI Infinity Portfolio is structured to provide shareholders with look-through exposure to frontier AI companies through SEC-registered, publicly traded closed-end funds.

Anthropic, the frontier AI laboratory and creator of the Claude family of AI models, is the largest look-through holding in the AI Treasury, representing approximately 18% of the Company’s initial investments and 21% of the Company’s AI Treasury as of today’s date. On November 18, 2026, Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 per share, raising approximately $81.3 billion in the largest initial public offering on record by initial offering size[1]. Shares began trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on November 19, 2026 under the ticker symbol “ANT”, with the offering valuing the company at approximately $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.

At the time of the Company’s first AI Treasury investments in June 2026, the most recent reported valuations of Anthropic and SpaceX at the time were $380 billion (February 2026 Series G funding round) and $1.25 trillion (SpaceX and xAI combined, February 2026), as cited in the Company’s August 27, 2026 release[2].

Anthropic was subsequently valued at $965 billion at its May 2026 Series H funding round, an increase of 154%, and at approximately $1.5 trillion at its IPO, an increase of 295% on its valuation at the time of the Company’s investment.

SpaceX, which listed on Nasdaq on June 12, 2026 at an IPO valuation of approximately $1.77 trillion, had a market capitalization of approximately $1.95 trillion based on its closing share price on November 18, 2026, more than 50% above the combined SpaceX and xAI valuation at the time of the Company’s investment.

Analysts are forecasting further growth. The average of the five analyst price targets published to date for Anthropic is $116.38, 40% above its IPO price[3], and the consensus analyst price target for SpaceX is $256.41 per 24/7 Wall St.[4]

Roger James Hamilton, CEO of Genius Group, stated: “We launched our AI Treasury strategy in May 2026 with the goal of giving our shareholders exposure to the most transformative companies in superintelligence. Yesterday, Anthropic joined SpaceX as the two private companies that AI Treasury had high exposure to that have since become publicly listed companies. The two companies are now trading on NASDAQ at a combined valuation of over $3 trillion. The AI economy is growing rapidly, and we believe our shareholders are positioned to benefit from this historic AI super-trend.”

“Genius Group has recently been trading at a share price which is at a fraction of its Net Asset Value Per Share. We believe that what we see as a potential market mispricing will increasingly be seen as an opportunity by long term investors as the value of our assets and our treasury continues to grow.”

The AI Treasury was established with the intention of giving Genius Group shareholders exposure to the growth of the AI economy alongside the Company’s AI-powered education business. The AI economy is growing rapidly. Gartner forecasts worldwide AI spending of $2.67 trillion in 2026, an increase of 49.5% on 2025, rising to $3.64 trillion in 2027[5].

The Company’s initial investment of US$657,100, made in June 2026 in Destiny Tech100 and Fundrise Innovation Fund, was the first step in the Company’s AI Treasury program. The Company intends to continue adding to its AI Treasury and, as announced on August 27, 2026, aims to fund its growth through perpetual preferred equity rather than ordinary shares.

Based on the funds’ most recent disclosures, the Company’s largest look-through holdings within its AI Treasury are Anthropic (21.3%), OpenAI (12.4%), SpaceX (7.3%) and Databricks (4.1%), compared to Anthropic (17.6%), SpaceX (11.7%), OpenAI (7.4%) and Databricks (5.4%) at the time of investment[6]:

The Company believes the success of the Anthropic and SpaceX IPOs, together with the ongoing demand for AI services and tools to power the world’s future economy, reinforce its thesis that by growing its AI treasury alongside its AI-powered education business preparing its students for the future, shareholders can benefit from both the human and capital opportunities created by the coming post-AGI economy.

Genius Group believes the benefit of its Treasury strategy will be realized over a long term horizon. By example, over the next five years, analyst revenue forecasts for Anthropic rise from between $52 billion to $53 billion in 2026 through to between $270 billion to $280 billion in 2028[3], and to between $505 billion and $685 billion in 2030[3][7]. Analyst consensus revenue estimates for SpaceX rise from $49.0 billion in 2026 to $181.3 billion in 2027[4], $330.9 billion in 2028[8] and $492.5 billion in 2030[9]. This analyst consensus equates to a forecasted 10x revenue growth by 2030.

Key Terms

form s-1regulatory
A Form S-1 is the registration filing a company submits to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission when it plans to offer stock to the public, most commonly for an initial public offering. Think of it as the company’s full disclosure packet or blueprint: it contains audited financials, business description, management background, risk factors and details of the offering, giving investors the information needed to judge the company’s financial health and potential risks before buying shares.
equity line of creditfinancial
An equity line of credit is a loan that allows homeowners to borrow money against the value of their property, similar to having a flexible credit card secured by their home. It matters to investors because it provides a way for property owners to access cash for various needs, which can influence real estate markets and overall economic activity. This type of credit offers ongoing borrowing capacity, making it a valuable financial tool for those with significant property equity.
senior credit facilityfinancial
A senior credit facility is a large loan or revolving line of credit that a company borrows from banks or lenders and that has first claim on the company’s cash and assets if the business runs into financial trouble. Think of it as the “first in line” debt with stronger repayment priority and usually stricter rules, so investors watch it because its size, cost and covenants affect a company’s cash flow, risk profile and the value of equity and other creditors.
stockholders' equityfinancial
Stockholders' equity is the portion of a company's assets that belongs to its owners after all debts and obligations are paid; think of it as the value left for shareholders if the company sold everything and paid off what it owes. Investors watch it because it shows the company's net worth, indicates how much of growth is funded by owners versus debt, and helps assess financial health and the potential for future dividends or stock value increases — like the equity in a house after the mortgage is settled.

Mercury Insurance explains what drivers should do before starting a flooded vehicle and how comprehensive auto coverage may help.

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Mercury Insurance (NYSE/NYSE TX: MCY) urges drivers whose cars have flooded to leave the engine off, even if the seats feel dry and the dashboard lights come on. Water can reach wiring beneath the carpet or enter the engine, and starting the car can make the damage worse. A qualified technician should inspect the vehicle before anyone attempts to drive it.

"It's a natural reaction to reach for the keys. You need to get to work, the water is gone and you want to know if the car still runs," said Michael Curcio, vice president of claims at Mercury Insurance. "Before starting your vehicle, take a moment to safely assess both your surroundings and the vehicle itself. If the vehicle was exposed to floodwater, starting it could be unsafe and may cause additional damage. Look for signs of water intrusion, such as mud, debris, or visible waterlines, and contact your insurer to report what you find. If possible, take photos showing how high the water reached. Even a simple photo of the waterline on the door can help your claims representative understand the situation and guide you through the next steps."

El Niño is currently helping to support an active pattern of atmospheric rivers across the West, including California. Atmospheric rivers can cause repeated rounds of heavy rain and widespread flooding. (https://www.noaa.gov/stories/what-are-atmospheric-rivers)

"If your garage, street or parking area has flooded before, choose another place to park before the storm arrives. Keep an eye on your local forecast and treat a flood watch or flood warning as a signal to move your car to higher ground" said Stephen Bennett, head of climate and catastrophe science at Mercury Insurance.

What to do if your car floods

  • Leave the vehicle off. If water entered the cabin or you suspect it reached the engine, skip the test drive, even a short one to the repair shop. Ask your insurer about towing and inspection. Electrical connections can corrode after the interior dries, so a problem may take time to appear.
     
  • Document what you can see safely. Wait until the water recedes and the area is safe to approach. Before cleaning up, photograph the vehicle, any visible waterline and the surrounding area. Note where the car was parked and approximately when the flooding occurred. Keep receipts for towing or storage.
     
  • Tell the tow operator if the vehicle is electric or hybrid. A flood-damaged high-voltage battery can pose a shock or fire risk. Leave the vehicle off, avoid plugging it in and contact the dealer for guidance. If you see smoke, sparks or flames, move away and call 911. Tell the dispatcher an electric or hybrid vehicle is involved.

Does auto insurance cover flood damage?

Comprehensive auto coverage generally helps pay for flood damage to the insured vehicle, subject to the policy's deductible and terms. Drivers can check the declarations page of their auto policy to see whether they carry comprehensive coverage on the affected car and which deductible applies. Liability-only coverage does not pay for flood damage to the driver's own vehicle.

Insurance coverage is subject to the terms, conditions, exclusions, limits and deductibles of the applicable policy. In amended complaint, Datavault AI Founder Nathaniel Bradley expands lawsuit, alleging undisclosed conflicts of interest and breaches of fiduciary duties

WILMINGTON, Del., Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Nathaniel Bradley, the founder whose technology became Nasdaq-listed Datavault AI Inc. (NASDAQ: DVLT), filed an amended complaint in the Delaware Court of Chancery last week expanding the allegations to include fraud, fraudulent concealment, negligent misrepresentation, constructive fraud, and breaches of fiduciary duties. Specifically, the amended complaint alleges the company's newly installed CEO, Brett Moyer, failed to disclose his personal financial interest in NYIAX, a company Datavault acquired earlier this year, prior to the transaction, and claims that two directors who voted to oust Bradley had undisclosed ties to a lender whose loan Datavault agreed to guarantee.

According to the complaint, Moyer, then CFO, owned shares of NYIAX but did not tell the Board before it approved buying the company. The complaint further alleges that while the deal was pending, Moyer committed Datavault to guaranteeing a loan from Abri Capital to NYIAX, despite NYIAX having defaulted on earlier Abri loans. Jeffrey Tirman and Christopher Hardt subsequently joined Datavault's Board and were designated independent directors. The complaint alleges that they failed to disclose to the Board conflicts arising from their Abri Capital affiliations and Datavault's guarantee.

According to the complaint, five days after Bradley's removal, the Board voted to install Moyer as CEO and appointed Hardt chair of the Audit Committee – the committee charged with overseeing potential conflicts of interest and exercising vigilance around the financial statements that now are the subject of a forthcoming restatement. The complaint alleges that Bradley, who continues to serve as a director, was excluded from this meeting.

"Best practices in corporate governance, as well as elementary director disclosure obligations, demand transparency into financial relationships that Datavault AI's shareholders are entitled to know," said Jacob Frenkel, Bradley's lead counsel. "As alleged in the complaint, undisclosed personal stakes in acquired companies and directors with undisclosed connections to that company's lender implicate fiduciary duties. Directors owe fiduciary duties of loyalty and candor, among others, to the company and its shareholders. The Court most respected in the U.S. for policing corporate governance breaches – the Delaware Court of Chancery – will scrutinize how these decisions were made and who stood to benefit from them."

Among other relief, the amended complaint asks the court to restore Bradley as CEO, undo the November 6 appointments, and block major dilutive deals while the case proceeds. AUSTIN, Texas, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Flex (NASDAQ: FLEX) today announced that its HV DC/DC Converter has been named a 2026 Automotive News PACE Award winner, recognizing its innovative approach to high-voltage power conversion designed for the evolving electrical demands of electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles.

As vehicle architectures become more electrified and software-defined, automakers face growing demands on the systems that power safety-critical and high-performance electrical functions. The Flex HV DC/DC Converter addresses these challenges with a scalable, bidirectional architecture that supports both 400V and 800V traction battery systems and responds quickly to dynamic vehicle loads.

"Winning a third PACE Award in two years is an honor and a testament to Flex's continued innovation in automotive power and compute," said Andreas Heim, Vice President of Automotive at Flex. "This latest recognition highlights our expanding capabilities across both high- and low-voltage power systems as automakers move toward increasingly sophisticated electrified vehicle architectures."

The DC/DC platform uses a dual active bridge-based architecture to provide wide input-voltage capability and bidirectional energy flow. By responding dynamically to changing electrical demands, it can help automakers simplify electrical architectures, reduce reliance on auxiliary low-voltage energy storage, and improve system reliability. It also supports higher-power applications and integration with onboard chargers, inverters, and software-defined power management.

The award builds on Flex's 2025 PACE Award for its Backup DC/DC Converter, which provides power continuity for essential drive-by-wire systems. The Automotive News PACE Awards recognize automotive supplier innovations that demonstrate significant technological advancement and business impact, as selected by an independent panel of judges.

COLUMBUS, Ohio, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Northwest Bank and the Center of Science and Industry (COSI) are helping Central Ohio students build practical financial skills and explore careers in banking through a new series of hands-on learning experiences.

The partnership officially launched at Ridgeview Middle School with a COSI HIVE (Human Innovation Experience) experience, a hands-on program that introduces students to real-world skills and careers through interactive activities. At the event, approximately 150 students went through five interactive stations led by COSI educators and Northwest Bank volunteers. At each station students explored financial concepts. They practiced budgeting while selecting materials to make slime and learned about risk management through a block-building exercise.

"Financial literacy is one of the most important life skills we can help foster in the communities we serve," said Devin Teles-Cygnar, chief marketing and communications officer and Northwest Bank Charitable Foundation president. "By teaming up with COSI, we have an opportunity to engage students in a meaningful way that helps build confidence, encourages curiosity and opens doors to future possibilities. Together, we're creating opportunities that help communities thrive."

Through a $125,000 contribution, Northwest will support additional HIVE events in four other Central Ohio communities served by the bank. 

"COSI believes learning is most powerful when it is relevant, engaging and connected to real-world opportunities and money is one of the first places young people engage in math in everyday life," said Dr. Frederic Bertley, president and CEO of COSI. "The HIVE-Fin-Lit edition was created on the premise that students deserve to see what is possible in the fields of mathematics, actuarial sciences and finance. Together with Northwest Bank, we can help students build financial confidence, explore future careers and develop the skills they need to succeed in our rapidly changing world. We are grateful to Northwest Bank for partnering with COSI to bring this important educational opportunity to students in the hometown we share."

Northwest will also support the development of a financial literacy learning kit created by COSI and the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland. The kit is designed to help families build practical skills in budgeting, saving, decision-making and financial planning.

This effort builds on Northwest's growing investment in Central Ohio. The bank recently opened its third Columbus financial center on Bethel Road, with new centers planned in Gahanna in December and Westerville in the first quarter of 2027 and a 75,000‑sq‑ft, purpose‑built corporate headquarters in Dublin, OH with relocation planned for 2029.
